items.title: Noodle Seed
items.name: Noodle Seed
items.summary: Your product in AI and AI in your product
items.description: Noodle Seed helps software teams make their products ready for AI agents. Build workflows in TypeScript, expose them through a secure branded assistant inside your product, and make the same capabilities available to external agents. Instead of stitching together MCP SDKs and hosting infrastructure, Noodle Seed provides the governed runtime for identity, permissions, secrets, audit, and operations.
top_comments:
Hi Product Hunt! 👋

We built Noodle Seed because software teams are being asked to add AI agents and agent interfaces, but one useful workflow can quickly turn into an infrastructure project. Teams end up rebuilding identity, permissions, secrets, rate limits, audit, hosting, and multi-tenancy before customers can get real work done.

Noodle Seed lets you start with a secure, customer-branded assistant inside your existing SaaS. It uses the product workflows, identity, data, and business rules you already trust. It’s industry-agnostic, so you can build conversational experiences for travel, e-commerce, restaurants, financial services, healthcare, or virtually any other vertical.

Developers define capabilities in TypeScript, prove them locally for free, and deploy them to a governed runtime. The same workflows can then expand to ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and other MCP clients when customers need them.

Our goal is simple: make your software ready for agents without replacing the product behind it. We’d love to hear which customer workflow you would make conversational first.
governed layer for the mcp mess is smart, most teams skip the permisions part 👏 congrats

Congrats on the launch! Really interesting approach to making products agent-ready without teams having to stitch together all the infrastructure themselves. Curious — what kinds of software products or workflows do you think are the best fit for Noodle Seed today?

items.title: Cline Desktop App
items.name: Cline Desktop App
items.summary: An open-source app for open-weight models
items.description: Cline Desktop gives you an open-source workspace to put your favourite model to work - run multiple agent sessions, automate recurring tasks, extend their capabilities through Cline’s Marketplace, and continue work from agents like Claude Code and Codex. Choose the models and providers that work best for you, while Cline’s agent harness, optimized for open-weight models, powers the work behind them. All without being tied to a closed ecosystem.
top_comments:
👋 Hey Product Hunt - I’m Saoud, founder of Cline.


What we’re launching today 🚀

Cline started as a VS Code extension and is now used by more than 11 million developers. Today, we’re launching Cline Desktop, an early version of our open source app for open weight models.

It brings the same Cline agent harness into a dedicated workspace where you can run agents in parallel, automate recurring work, extend what Cline can do through the Marketplace, and import tasks from other coding agents to keep going in Cline.

Cline Desktop is available on Mac, with Windows in beta.


👉 Download Cline Desktop: https://cline.bot/desktop


Why Cline Desktop❓

As we started delegating more work to agents ourselves, we found that keeping track of multiple agents, tasks, and context gets difficult pretty quickly.

The IDE extension and CLI work well when you’re actively working alongside an agent. But as you delegate more work, we think there should be a better place to manage those tasks together.

We also want Cline to complement the tools you already use. We jump between models and agents too, so being able to import a task from Claude Code or Codex and continue it in Cline was important to us.

What you can do with Cline Desktop ✨

🔷 Choose the models and providers that work best for you, including 300+ models through Cline, open-weight models through ClinePass, local models, or your own API keys
🔷 Import tasks from Claude Code, Codex, and other supported agents and continue with the existing context
🔷 Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, research, and other work
🔷 Schedule recurring tasks like PR reviews, repo checks, and documentation updates
🔷 Discover and manage plugins, MCP servers, and skills through Cline’s Marketplace
🔷 Use web search and voice input to bring in outside context and give longer instructions
🔷 You can also start a task in Cline CLI or VS Code extension and pick it up again in the Desktop app.


Where we’re headed ✨

This is still an early version, and we want to learn how people use agents beyond the IDE and terminal.

We’re excited to share Cline Desktop with the Product Hunt community and would love your feedback on what works, what feels rough, and what you’d like us to build next.
This could be a great fit for repository maintenance and dependency checks, test coverage, small refactors, documentation updates, and similar tasks that tend to accumulate.

idea_items.title: 教育 AI 辅导
idea_items.need_line: 语文老师备一节新课往往要花八到十小时，时间反复消耗在教案撰写、资料考据和课前试讲这几个具体环节上。
idea_items.status_line: 眼下老师多靠一份教学工具清单逐个拼凑，用 Google 表单出随堂测验、用在线时间轴做年表、用国家大小对比工具讲地图，讨论还停留在单点工具替代，很少触及备课流程本身。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是面向语文这类“备课即重活”的学科，把资料检索、教案初稿生成和课前试讲串成一条可核查的连贯辅助链路，让老师在自身知识盲区上快速拿到可信参考，而不是再添一个测验或可视化小工具。

idea_items.title: 语言 AI 陪练
idea_items.need_line: 学了多年英语的人仍难以连续流利地说完一段话，且练习时需要即时得到卡顿、用词和语法层面的反馈。
idea_items.status_line: 现有口语提升多被归因于阅读基础不足，练习者靠零散自练、外教或高星英语工具辅助，缺少针对长段落连续表达的反馈闭环。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是围绕“连续表达”的追问式陪练机制：在一次对话里持续追问、即时纠错，并逐步拉长用户的回答长度。

interest_sections.title: 法律 AI 工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是合同审查的耗时源于交易背景缺失，AI 的机会在把“先问清背景再审查”这个最耗人的环节变成自动化交互。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 律师审一份合同前必须弄清交易模式、背景，客户却以为“甩个文件半小时就能确认”，导致一次审查往往要数天反复沟通

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 普通人习惯直接用网上的模板合同，律师靠微信反复向客户确认背景信息，已有 LexAI 等 LLM 工具把合同审查、起草、对比打包成智能体，但仍未解决背景采集问题。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是让 AI 在审查前主动向用户提问交易结构与商业意图、形成带背景假设的风险清单，而非只对文本做静态审查。

vendor_news_items.title: Mistral SDK python - v2.10.0 - 2026-09-09 13:27:17 发布
vendor_news_items.raw_summary: # Generated by Speakeasy CLI ## 2026-09-09 10:25:27 ### API changes Removed (19): - campaigns.create - campaigns.delete - campaigns.fetch - campaigns.fetch_status - campaigns.list - campaigns.list_events - chatcompletionevents.fetch - chatcompletionevents.fetch_similar_events - chatcompletionevents.judge - chatcompletionevents.search - chatcompletionevents.search_ids - connectors.create_or_update_organization_credentials - connectors.create_or_update_user_credentials - connectors.create_or_update_workspace_credentials - datasets.import_from_campaign - datasets.import_from_explorer - fields.fetch_option_counts - fields.fetch_options - fields.list Added (17): - connectors.create_credentials - connectors.share_to_organization - connectors.unshare_from_organization - connectors.update_credentials - evaluations.create_pipeline_config - evaluations.delete_pipeline_config - evaluations.get_pipeline_config - evaluations.list_pipeline_configs - evaluations.update_pipeline_config - serviceaccounts.create - serviceaccounts.delete - serviceaccounts.get - serviceaccounts.list - serviceaccounts.list_assignable_roles - serviceaccounts.list_roles - serviceaccounts.set_roles - serviceaccounts.update ### Breaking changes Connectors - `connectors.create` now takes a single request object, and `connectors.update` a `request_body`. The named arguments (`name`, `description`, `server`, `title`, ...) are no longer accepted. - `Connector` is now a union of `HTTPConnector` and `MCPConnector`, discriminated on `protocol`. Fields that were flat on `Connector` now live on the variant. - `protocol` is required on the create payload. In TypeScript it no longer defaults to `"mcp"`, so it must be passed explicitly. Python still defaults it. Other models - `ExtendedOAuthServerMetadata.authorization_endpoint` is now optional. - `UsageInfoDollarDefs.service_tier` has been removed. - Three fields on `DeploymentWorkerSpecResponse` are now required. ### Fixed - Transcription segment `start` and `end` are now nullable. The API can return null for these, so diarized transcriptions previously failed to parse. ### Changes Based on: - OpenAPI Doc - Speakeasy CLI 1.796.1 (2.933.0) https://github.com/speakeasy-api/speakeasy ### Generated - [python v2.10.0] . ### Releases - [PyPI v2.10.0] https://pypi.org/project/mistralai/2.10.0 - . Publishing Completed

high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 可嵌进笔记本的 Agent 微型虚拟机
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 最值得借鉴的是把 Agent 的代码执行装进同一个微型虚拟机运行时里，本地开发时嵌进笔记本进程，上线时同一套隔离能力直接扩到云端，省去两套沙箱环境的维护。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版先用 Rust 做一个单进程微型虚拟机，一条命令在本地启动，隔离执行一段 Agent 生成的代码并把标准输出和退出码返回给调用方，先不做集群和多租户调度。

interest_sections.title: AI 应用场景 / 数据
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，核心观察是场景与素材的结构化梳理耗时被反复提及，但公开讨论只给到零散单点工具，缺的正是把杂乱输入转成结构化场景清单的中间环节。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 产品经理在做 B 端业务全场景梳理时，需要把角色、流程节点和数据字段逐条对齐成可评审的清单，这一步靠人工访谈加文档反复补漏，最耗时

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现有做法是用单点在线工具拼凑：拿 Google 表单做随堂测验和实时评分、用时间轴工具把教学资料做成 3D 年表、用国家大小比对工具做可视化演示，而 B 端场景梳理仍停在人工访谈加文档整理。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是从访谈记录、课件草稿这类杂乱输入中自动抽取「角色—流程—数据」结构并产出可继续编辑的场景清单，而不是再做一个通用表单或可视化模板。

interest_sections.title: 教育 AI 辅导
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，老师吐槽的核心不是缺工具，而是备课本身耗时长且专业门槛高，现有解法还停留在零散工具拼接层面。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 语文老师备一节新课常要花八到十小时，痛点在教案撰写、资料考据和课前试讲这些具体环节上反复耗时

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现在老师的做法是拿一份教学工具清单逐个拼凑，用 Google 表单出随堂测验、用在线时间轴做年表、用国家大小对比工具讲地图，讨论集中在单点工具的替代，而非备课流程本身。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是围绕语文这类备课即重活的学科，把资料检索、教案初稿生成和课前试讲串成可核查的连贯辅助，让老师在自身知识盲区上快速拿到可信参考，而不是再增加一个测验或可视化小工具。

interest_sections.title: 语言 AI 陪练
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，核心观察是：口语练习的瓶颈在连续流利输出，陪练产品应优先验证长段落表达中的即时反馈和话题延展。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 用户最明确的需求是：学了多年英语后，仍需要完成“连续流利说一段话”的口语任务，并希望练习过程能即时指出卡顿、用词和语法问题

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前讨论把口语差归因于阅读未过关，练习者多靠零散自练、外教或 GitHub 高星英语工具辅助，但缺少针对长段落连续表达的反馈闭环。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是把口语陪练做成围绕“连续表达”的追问与纠错机制，让用户在一次对话里被连续追问、即时改错并延长回答长度。

interest_sections.title: 法律 AI 工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是合同审查的耗时源于交易背景缺失，AI 的机会在把“先问清背景再审查”这个最耗人的环节变成自动化交互。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 律师审一份合同前必须弄清交易模式、背景，客户却以为“甩个文件半小时就能确认”，导致一次审查往往要数天反复沟通

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 普通人习惯直接用网上的模板合同，律师靠微信反复向客户确认背景信息，已有 LexAI 等 LLM 工具把合同审查、起草、对比打包成智能体，但仍未解决背景采集问题。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是让 AI 在审查前主动向用户提问交易结构与商业意图、形成带背景假设的风险清单，而非只对文本做静态审查。

product_items.title: abaiar/-LexAI
product_items.highlight_one_liner: 面向法律 AI 工作流的轻量产品样本
product_items.reuse_direction: 把「法律 AI 工作流」封装成更明确的岗位或任务入口
product_items.minimal_mvp: 先围绕“律师审一份合同前必须弄清交易模式、背景，客户却以为“甩个文件半小时就能确认”，导致一次审查往往要数天反复沟通”做单任务 MVP，优先打通输入、执行和结果回传
